# Chase Construction LLC

> Custom log home builders, big timber framing, and log home restoration serving Sun Valley, Ketchum, Hailey, and Bellevue, Idaho. Three decades of craftsmanship building and restoring luxury log homes engineered to last generations in the Idaho mountains.

Chase Construction LLC is a general contractor based in Bellevue, Idaho, specializing in high-end log and timber construction across the Wood River Valley and the wider Sun Valley corridor. The company builds custom log homes from design through completion, executes big-timber structural framing, and restores weathered or failing log homes — including re-chinking, re-staining, and structural log repair. Contact: 208-897-8100 · https://www.chaseconstruction.org

## Services

- [Custom Log Homes](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/custom-log-homes.html): Full-service custom log home construction in Sun Valley, Ketchum, and Hailey, Idaho — from design to completion, managing every detail.
- [Big Timber Framing](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/big-timber-framing.html): Structural timber framing for luxury homes — big-timber expertise that defines the scale and character of exceptional homes.
- [Log Home Restorations](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/log-home-restorations.html): Log home restoration and maintenance — individual log repair and replacement, structural repair, through full restoration.
- [Log Home Chinking & Staining](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/log-home-chinking-staining.html): Re-chinking failing joints and re-staining weathered logs to seal a log home against Idaho weather — the maintenance page for existing log homes.
- [Custom Log Finishes & Siding](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/custom-log-finishes-siding.html): Log siding installation and custom exterior finish carpentry for new builds, additions, and retrofits.
- [Traditional Framing](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/traditional-framing.html): Precision residential framing for complex, high-end builds near Boise and the Sun Valley corridor.
- [Milling & More](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/milling-and-more.html): On-site bandsaw and circular milling, lumber cut to specification, cabinetry, and specialty builds.

- [Building From Out of State](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/building-from-out-of-state.html): Construction and log home maintenance for out-of-state owners — structured communication, photo and video updates, and one point of contact on the ground in Sun Valley.

## Guides

- [How Much Does Log Home Chinking Cost in Idaho?](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/blog/log-home-chinking-cost-idaho.html): How linear-foot chinking pricing works, the five factors that drive cost, and when a spot repair beats a full re-chink.
- [How to Tell When Your Log Home Needs Re-Staining](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/blog/log-home-restaining-signs-idaho.html): Graying, chalking, blotchy color, water soaking in flat — the four signs your stain is done protecting the wood, and which walls fail first.
- [Preparing Your Log Home for an Idaho Winter: A Fall Checklist](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/blog/log-home-winter-preparation-checklist.html): The six things to check on your log home every fall — from chinking joints to snow splashback zones — before the first hard freeze.
- [Do You Need an Owner's Representative in Sun Valley?](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/blog/owners-representative-sun-valley.html): What an owner's rep does, when hiring one genuinely makes sense, and when transparency from your builder covers the same job. An honest take.
